english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a customer or someone using a service.

exampleSentences.english: This client wants to buy this phone.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢位客人想買呢部手機。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 wai2 haak3 jan4 soeng2 maai5 ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a customer of a shop, restaurant, or similar business.

exampleSentences.english: Every patron at this cha chaan teng says the milk tea is good.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢間茶記每個客人都話啲奶茶好飲。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 mui5 go3 haak3 jan4 dou1 waa6 di1 naai5 caa4 hou2 jam2

english.note: Use this especially for a customer in a shop, restaurant, hotel, or other service setting, though it can also mean guest.

exampleSentences.english: The customer said they wanted another iced lemon tea.
exampleSentences.traditional: 客人話要加多杯凍檸茶。
exampleSentences.jyutping: haak3 jan4 waa6 jiu3 gaa1 do1 bui1 dung3 ling4 caa4

english.note: Use this colloquial term when the consumer is a customer dealing with a shop or service provider.

exampleSentences.english: The consumer can ask the waiter to change tables.
exampleSentences.jyutping: haak3 jan4 ho2 ji5 giu3 si6 jing3 wun6 wai2
